positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Build systems to reduce bad experiences across Facebook's family of apps at scale.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on developing/enhancing  software infrastructure
Some Tasks / Projects performed:

 - Implemented on an order management / tracker for business network equipment.
 - Designed & Implemented a human tasking system based on Bonita BPM software and JVM based Spring-boot microservices.
 - Enhanced an in-house JVM web application framework to support dynamic business logic                   with Groovy lang scripting. 
- Performed JVM performance analysis and tuning for the aforementioned web framework, CPU and memory usage with JDK's JVIsualVM.  
 -  Developed several web based UI for two internal facing systems (Network Inventory, Service Activation).  
 -  Integrated several web based UI to RESTful backend services.
 -  Contributed to systems, libraries and frameworks architectural design decisions.
 -  Configured  & deployed Logstash, Elasticsearch, Kibana (ELK) stack for server log management.
 -  Documented setup, configuration and deployment of aforementioned responsibilities.

positions.title: Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a feature-based telephone service activation system in the VoIP (Voice over IP) domain. 
My responsibilities included:
- Configuring and deploying of systems's GUI usage metrics collection capabilities.
- Enhancing existing GUI views to support responsiveness, HTML 5, and cross-browser compatibility.
- Prototyping and integrating a GUI view into a new separate system while maintaining both systems architecture compatibility & functionality. 
- Documenting the aforementioned integration process.

positions.title: Researcher - Access Control
positions.description:
Designed & implemented an approach through the use of fingerprints to remotely access (outside hospital grounds) a patient’s health record while still preserving their privacy. 

A detailed explanation of the works is included in the publications section.

projects.title: Pragma, A Web Irrigation Management Tool (Capstone Project)
projects.description:
Pragma is a web application designed to provide irrigation management services to farmers. Additionally, it provides registered agricultural scientists access to Puerto Rico wide hydro-climate data. Primarily, Pragma provides farmers with the proper amount of water to irrigate their crops. It keeps track of your crop’s growth stage, irrigation history, your farm’s geographical location, and collects the previously mentioned hydro-climate data daily from the GOES satellite and NEXRAD radar. It's available for both mobile and desktop use. 
  - Worked on the automation of hydro-climate data collection & storage for the application server 
  - Technologies: Unix, Cron jobs, Java, JDBC, Maven.

publications.title: Biometric Access Control for e-Health Records in Pre- hospital Care
publications.publisher: 6th International Workshop on Privacy and Anonymity in the Information Society · Mar 18, 2013
